messages:
nina: Quick note — onboarding seeing mixed env var names again: some samples use RW_TOKEN, others REDWOOD_API_KEY. Confusing customers.
omar: we should pick one canonical. my vote: REDWOOD_API_KEY + optional REDWOOD_ORG and REDWOOD_PROJECT.
nina: agree. Also need clear precedence: explicit client arg > REDWOOD_* envs > ~/.redwood/profile > legacy aliases.
omar: add fallback for 9 months: read RW_TOKEN and process.env.API_KEY, but emit a single deprecation metric (no key data). devex-bot: created ticket DX-519 for deprecation telemetry.
infra-bot: auth-service will start returning X-Redwood-Kid and X-Redwood-Exp headers on 2025-03-01 to help SDKs handle rotation.
nina: SDK ask: support tokenFile hot-reload (k8s secrets) and a TokenProvider hook with getToken() and onChange(cb). Makes zero-downtime rotate easier.
omar: I'll open the umbrella issue and assign per-sdk owners. We should also ship a small CLI helper: `rw auth rotate --service web` to update common deploy targets.
nina: perfect. I'll draft docs and a migration checklist for customers to follow.
devex-bot: reminder: RFC review on Fri 9am.
